ohtani.title: Andy Pages' pair of RBIs leads Dodgers to 4-2 win
ohtani.blurb: Andy Pages drives in two runs while Edwin Díaz earned the save in his first game since April, giving the Dodgers a 4-2 win over the Mariners

imanaga.title: Pete Crow-Armstrong's big day powers Cubs' win
imanaga.blurb: Pete Crow-Armstrong tallies three RBIs and Shota Imanaga tosses six scoreless innings in the Cubs' shutout win against the Pirates

suzuki.title: Iván Herrera walks it off with two-run double
suzuki.blurb: Iván Herrera walks it off for the Cardinals in the bottom of the 10th with a two-run double to defeat the Cubs

yoshida.title: Andruw Monasterio's homer in 10th gives Red Sox win
yoshida.blurb: Andruw Monasterio hits a two-run home run in the 10th inning and Patrick Sandoval strikes out seven in the Red Sox's 4-2 win over the Athletics

okamoto.title: Varsho, Okamoto and Yesavage lead Blue Jays to a win
okamoto.blurb: Daulton Varsho and Kazuma Okamoto hit clutch RBI base hits to back Trey Yesavage's start, leading the Blue Jays to a 5-2 win over Nationals

murakami.title: Murakami, Quero rally White Sox to walk off win in 12
murakami.blurb: Munetaka Murakami belts a game-tying home run and Edgar Quero walks it off as the White Sox rally to beat the Yankees in 12 innings, 6-5

matsui.title: Machado and Merrill homer in Padres' comeback win
matsui.blurb: Padres rally late, led by game-tying and go-ahead homers by Manny Machado and Jackson Merrill, to beat the Marlins 5-3 and complete the sweep
